changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE conversation_entry ADD CONSTRAINT ck_conv_entry_text_role CHECK (type <> 'TEXT' OR message_type IN ('HUMAN', 'ASSISTANT', 'SYSTEM'))
changeSet.comment: Backfill typed messages without duplicating matching terminal voice entries.
changeSet.sql: WITH candidate_messages AS ( SELECT m.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY m.chat_id, m.tenant_id, m.type, m.text, m.user_id, m.creationuser ORDER BY m.creationdate ASC NULLS LAST, m.guid ) AS matching_row FROM message m JOIN chat c ON c.guid = m.chat_id AND c.tenant_id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.type IN ('HUMAN', 'ASSISTANT') ), ranked_voice_entries AS ( SELECT e.guid, e.chat_id, e.tenant_id, e.type, e.text, e.user_id, e.creationuser, COALESCE(e.modificationdate, e.creationdate) AS terminal_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY e.chat_id, e.tenant_id, e.type, e.text, e.user_id, e.creationuser ORDER BY COALESCE(e.modificationdate, e.creationdate) ASC NULLS LAST, e.guid ) AS matching_row FROM conversation_entry e WHERE e.type IN ('HUMAN', 'ASSISTANT') AND e.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'INTERRUPTED') AND e.legacy_message_id IS NULL ) UPDATE conversation_entry e SET legacy_message_id = m.guid FROM candidate_messages m JOIN ranked_voice_entries v ON v.chat_id = m.chat_id AND v.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND v.type = m.type AND v.text IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.text AND v.user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.user_id AND v.creationuser IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.creationuser AND v.matching_row = m.matching_row AND v.terminal_date BETWEEN m.creationdate - INTERVAL '1 second' AND m.creationdate + INTERVAL '1 second' WHERE e.guid = v.guid;

WITH candidate_messages AS ( SELECT m.* FROM message m JOIN chat c ON c.guid = m.chat_id AND c.tenant_id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.type IN ('HUMAN', 'ASSISTANT', 'SYSTEM') ), messages_to_backfill AS ( SELECT m.* FROM candidate_messages m WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM conversation_entry e WHERE e.chat_id = m.chat_id AND e.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND e.idempotency_key = 'legacy-message:' || m.guid ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM conversation_entry e WHERE e.chat_id = m.chat_id AND e.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND e.legacy_message_id = m.guid ) ) INSERT INTO conversation_entry (guid, optlock, tenant_id, chat_id, sequence_no, idempotency_key, text, type, status, user_id, message_type, creationdate, modificationdate, creationuser, modificationuser) SELECT m.guid, m.optlock, m.tenant_id, m.chat_id, COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(e.sequence_no) FROM conversation_entry e WHERE e.chat_id = m.chat_id AND e.tenant_id = m.tenant_id ), 0) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY m.chat_id, m.tenant_id ORDER BY m.creationdate ASC NULLS LAST, m.guid ), 'legacy-message:' || m.guid, m.text, 'TEXT', 'COMPLETED', m.user_id, m.type, m.creationdate, m.modificationdate, m.creationuser, m.modificationuser FROM messages_to_backfill m
